note: Only items returned by BOTH arms are compared. Pairing is by ITEM KEY and not by passage, because `query` reports one hit per item and never says which passage it centred on — so a pair is "the same item's best hit", read the same way on both sides. A snippet that begins at character 0 carries no leading ellipsis, which makes the discriminator mechanical rather than a judgement about readability; one with no trailing ellipsis either is a passage shorter than the 240-character window, returned whole whatever the query, and those are counted apart because no pruning could move them.
